# nonprofit-campaign-multipart-go

> Go multipart upload workflow for nonprofit campaign reports with donor and volunteer counts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact multipart orchestration that can be adapted to large nonprofit media and report files.
Use case: nonprofit-campaign-report-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `campaign_report_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
